title: Professional Services Agreement

issues.quote: This Professional Services Agreement (this "Agreement") is effective as of 3/1/2027 (the "Effective Date") and is between Tallgrass Regional Medical Center, Inc., a Kansas nonprofit corporation (the "Client"), and Meridian Point Consulting, LLC, a Georgia limited liability company (the "Consultant").
issues.fix: March 1, 2027

issues.quote: This Professional Services Agreement (this "Agreement") is effective as of 3/1/2027 (the "Effective Date") and is between Tallgrass Regional Medical Center, Inc., a Kansas nonprofit corporation (the "Client"), and Meridian Point Consulting, LLC, a Georgia limited liability company (the "Consultant").
issues.why: Document-wide: both party names defined and used with "the" (the Client, the Consultant).
issues.fix: Define ("Client") and ("Consultant"); drop "the" throughout.

issues.quote: 1. DEFINITIONS
issues.why: Top-level sections numbered 1.-7. with (a) under them; a contract without articles starts at A., then 1., then (a) (house rule 3).
issues.fix: A. Definitions; 1., 2. for subsections.

issues.quote: "Services" shall mean the revenue-cycle consulting services in Appendix A attached hereto.
issues.fix: "Services" means ...

issues.quote: "Services" shall mean the revenue-cycle consulting services in Appendix A attached hereto.
issues.fix: the revenue-cycle consulting services in Schedule A.

issues.quote: APPENDIX A
issues.why: "Appendix" label. The list of services is information the body refers to, so it is a schedule.
issues.fix: Schedule A

issues.quote: The Consultant shall execute the Services at the Client's hospital in Wichita, Kansas, and remotely.
issues.why: "execute" is a term of art for signing; here it means perform.
issues.fix: Consultant shall perform the Services ...

issues.quote: The Consultant shall have the right to subcontract any part of the Services with the Client's written consent.
issues.why: "shall have the right to" grants discretion, not a duty.
issues.fix: Consultant may subcontract any part of the Services with Client's written consent.

issues.quote: The Client must pay the Consultant $185 per hour for the Services, plus a one-time onboarding fee of $2,500.
issues.why: "must" for a duty on the subject, a party.
issues.fix: Client shall pay Consultant $185 per hour ...

issues.quote: The Client shall reimburse travel expenses incurred by the Consultant, provided, however, that the Consultant obtains the Client's written approval before incurring any single expense over $500.
issues.fix: travel expenses that Consultant incurs

issues.quote: The Client shall reimburse travel expenses incurred by the Consultant, provided, however, that the Consultant obtains the Client's written approval before incurring any single expense over $500.
issues.fix: Client shall reimburse travel expenses that Consultant incurs, but only if Consultant obtains Client's written approval before incurring any single expense over $500.

issues.quote: The Consultant shall invoice the Client monthly, and the Client shall pay each invoice no later than fifteen (15) days after the day on which the Client receives it.
issues.fix: 15 days

issues.quote: It is understood and agreed that the Consultant is an independent contractor and not an employee of the Client.
issues.fix: Consultant is an independent contractor and not an employee of Client.

issues.quote: It is understood and agreed that the Consultant is an independent contractor and not an employee of the Client. The Consultant's personnel shall comply with the Client's safety and patient-privacy policies while on the Client's premises.
issues.fix: 2 spaces after "Client."

issues.quote: The Consultant's personnel shall comply with the Client's safety and patient-privacy policies while on the Client's premises.
issues.why: "shall" with a nonparty subject (Consultant's personnel don't sign).
issues.fix: Consultant shall cause its personnel to comply with Client's safety and patient-privacy policies ...

issues.quote: The Consultant shall keep confidential all patient information and other non-public information of the Client and/or its affiliates that the Consultant obtains in performing the Services.
issues.fix: of Client, of Client's affiliates, or of both

issues.quote: On termination, the Client shall pay the Consultant all fees that accrued through the termination date under Section 3(a) above.
issues.fix: under the section titled "Fees and Expenses"

issues.quote: All provisions of this Agreement that by their nature should survive termination shall survive termination.
issues.why: Generic survival clause (the "should" inside it is part of the same problem).
issues.fix: Delete; state survival periods for specific provisions where needed (MSCD 13.822-13.831).

issues.quote: The parties may amend the terms and conditions of this Agreement only by a writing that both parties sign.
issues.fix: The parties may amend this agreement only by a writing that both parties sign.

issues.quote: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
issues.fix: The parties are signing this agreement as of the Effective Date.

traps.quote: The Client is not required to provide office space or equipment to the Consultant's personnel.
The Client must pay the Consultant $185 per hour for the Services, plus a one-time onboarding fee of $2,500.
The Consultant shall invoice the Client monthly, and the Client shall pay each invoice no later than fifteen (15) days after the day on which the Client receives it.
The Deliverables are works made for hire under the Copyright Act, and the Client owns all rights in the Deliverables.
traps.why_correct: Statutory term (Copyright Act); keep as is.

notes: Whose draft is unknown. Party-article and section enumeration are document-wide, anchored at the 1st occurrence. The planted spacing error is the single space after "of the Client." in section 4; every other sentence break has 2 spaces. The survival issue subsumes the "should" inside that sentence; a category-should finding on that sentence should be matched to it. The Appendix (a)-(c) list and the 2(c) sentence are clean.
